name: Former Villagers Among the Heathens Leave Skeletons
description: **Only matters with "Former Villagers Keep Aging Among the Heathens" or "Heathen Tribe Ages, Dies and Has Children" ticked**: in the normal game a Heathen never ages, so never dies of old age. When a villager who had left your tribe dies of old age among the Heathens, they leave a skeleton like any villager: your believers bury it with "Burying the dead" (once The Buried Mausoleum is solved), which gives a normal grave. Other Heathens who die leave nothing. **Cannot be ticked with "All Heathens Leave Skeletons"**: ticking one unticks the other. The Death record says how they died; **Heathens never count in the Village Statistics.**
behavior_changes: While this file is shipped, VVFP Heathen Aging.dll lets a former villager who dies of old age among the Heathens leave a body (SetHealth 0x4758B0(0, 2)) for the believers' burial; any other Heathen who dies leaves nothing.
explicit_non_changes: Nothing happens unless a Heathen aging row is ticked: in the stock game no Heathen dies of old age.
